correctness.rationale: For every finite simple undirected edge-transitive G with m>0, tr(AB)=2m for every feasible B and trace/operator duality yields norm >=2m/tr|A|. The sign involution U=I-2P_-(A) commutes with every graph automorphism; edge transitivity forces constant edge entry tr|A|/(2m), hence scaled U meets all constraints with equality, including zero adjacency eigenvalues and disconnected graphs. The Fourier series of |cos| yields the three cycle residues and correct n^-2 coefficients. An independently implemented symmetric eigendecomposition of C3..C14 yielded maximum prescribed-edge error 1.34e-15. Only one minimizer, not uniqueness, is claimed.
